```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parsed entity value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bin SYSTEM "binary.dat" NDATA png>
  <?target processing instruction data?>
  <!-- Document type declaration comment -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" sub:id="1">
  <!-- Root level comment -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like characters: <tag> & "quotes"
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ext "External Text Reference">
  <?catalog-pi status="active"?>
  <!-- Catalog DTD internal subset comment -->
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level comment before item -->
  <?custom-action execute="true"?>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA section with unescaped <, >, and & characters.
    ]]>
    &ext;
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA section following an entity reference.
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_pe "<!ENTITY internal 'resolved'>">
  %local_pe;
  <?doc-info author="Tester"?>
  <!-- DTD internal subset comment block -->
]>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.base.uri" xmlns:custom="http://xml.custom.uri" custom:version="2.0">
  <!-- Comment inside the root element -->
  <?custom-pi data="test-processing-instruction"?>
  <custom:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with nested structures: <node attr="val"/> & others.
    ]]>
    &internal;
  </custom:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY prod_ent "Standard Product Description">
  <?inventory-mgmt mode="strict"?>
  <!-- Inventory DTD comment -->
]>
<inventory xmlns="urn:inventory:schema" xmlns:inv="urn:inventory:namespace">
  <!-- Comment preceding namespaced element -->
  <?inv:processor command="validate"?>
  <inv:product>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with special symbols: &&& <<< >>> ''' """
    ]]>
    &prod_ent;
  </inv:product>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref "Archived Record Data">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc_bin SYSTEM "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?archive-meta version="1.0"?>
  <!-- Archive DTD comment block -->
]>
<archive xmlns="http://schema.archive.org/ns" xmlns:arc="http://schema.archive.org/arc">
  <!-- Comment before metadata -->
  <?arc:log level="debug"?>
  <arc:record>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw data inside CDATA containing DTD syntax like <!ELEMENT> and &ref;
    ]]>
    &ref;
  </arc:record>
</archive>
